text:
ize_sales: Quick ask — Apollo Labs (public-sector channel partner) requests a one-time ‘price protection’ adjustment after competing RFQ quoted lower unit price. They want a retroactive concession of $42,000 across Q1 invoices + Net90 to align with procurement timing. They say if we don't accommodate they'll go with competitor.

maria_finance: Oof. Need details: which invoices, why retroactive, and confirm this isn't related to usage anomaly. Also note: credits >$25k require CFO approval; extended Net90 affects DSO/working capital.

ize_sales: Invoices: AP-1010, AP-1022, AP-1033. Reason: competitor offered lower per-call rate; Apollo wants a one-time adjustment so their resell margin is preserved. No usage anomaly — charges are valid. They’re asking also for a 12-month rate protection (no list increases) if we approve.

sam_legal: Contract implications: retroactive price changes require amendment to MSA/SOW and will need non-precedent language. Net90 for public-sector deals is common but we should require a PO and a signed amendment. We can draft protective language: "One-time commercial accommodation; not an admission of liability; applies only to listed invoices and contingent on signed amendment and PO."

devon_fp&a: Financial impact: $42k credit will reduce recognized revenue if prior periods closed — need to confirm treatment with external auditor but normally book as contra-revenue (GL 6300) and hit current period if immaterial, otherwise prior period adjustment. Net90 will push DSO; recommend 50% payment upfront or a performance bond. Also, the 12-month price protection is a revenue commitment risk — we should cap volume exposure.

billing-bot: System constraints: Manual credits >$25k require CFO approval and an approved finance ticket. Changing payment terms to Net90 triggers collections workflow and requires AR to set a custom due date. Attach docs to ticket FIN-8407.

tess_customer_success: Apollo is strategic for our Gov channel. They've committed to a joint bid pipeline valued at ~$600k ARR if we agree to make concessions. CS can help with milestone-based acceptance to reduce risk.

maria_finance: Proposal for decision: 1) Approve 60% of requested credit = $25,200 (GL 6300) to stay within precedent limits; 2) Require Apollo to sign amendment & provide PO; 3) Approve Net90 conditional on 30% upfront and milestone-based 30/30 remainder; 4) Approve 12-month price protection capped at $250k run-rate. Requires CFO ok for the >$25k portion.

jonah_cfo: Reviewed. I will approve conditional path but with stricter cash protections: 1) Approve $25,200 one-time credit now. 2) For remaining $16,800, we will hold as contingent credit payable after verification of LOI + signed 12-month guarantee and evidence of pipeline ($600k). If those conditions are met within 45 days we will post the remainder. 3) Net90 okay only with 30% upfront and validated PO. 4) Legal to draft amendment with non-precedent language and audit rights. Finance to book $25,200 GL 6300 and create contingent liability memo for $16,800 under FIN-8407.

ize_sales: Acknowledged. Will get PO + LOI and confirm payment schedule. Apollo is willing to accept milestone-based remainder.

sam_legal: Drafting amendment and the contingency clause now. Will include audit right and explicit non-precedent language.

maria_finance: I'll post the $25,200 credit memo and book GL 6300. I'll create FIN-8407 and flag contingent $16,800. AR: please set payment schedule. Closing loop once docs uploaded. :white_check_mark:
